```{r}
pdb_data <- read.csv("pdb_stats.csv") 

xray <- sum(pdb_data$X.ray, na.rm = TRUE) 
em <- sum(pdb_data$EM, na.rm = TRUE)
sum_em_and_xray <- sum(pdb_data$Total, na.rm = TRUE)

pct_xray_em <- ((xray + em) / sum_em_and_xray) * 100

pct_xray_em
```

> Q1: What percentage of structures in the PDB are solved by X-Ray and Electron Microscopy.

> Q2: What proportion of structures in the PDB are protein?

> Q3: Type HIV in the PDB website search box on the home page and determine how many HIV-1 protease structures are in the current PDB?

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```


Here we complete Lab 9, section 5, all about comparative analysis of protein structures.

## Setup

Load the pacakages we need for our full analysis

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(bio3d)
```

## Analysis Pipeline

The main input will be a single database ID (accession number). We can change this in the future to run our analysis on any protein familly.

```{r}
id <- "1ake_A"
```

```{r}
aa <- get.seq(id)
aa
```

```{r}
# Blast or hmmer search 
#b <- blast.pdb(aa)
#b <- blast.pdb(aa)
```

```{r}
hits <- NULL
hits$pdb.id <- c('1AKE_A','6S36_A','6RZE_A','3HPR_A','1E4V_A','5EJE_A','1E4Y_A','3X2S_A','6HAP_A','6HAM_A','4K46_A','3GMT_A','4PZL_A')
```

```{r}
# Download releated PDB files
files <- get.pdb(hits$pdb.id, path="pdbs", split=TRUE, gzip=TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Align releated PDBs
pdbs <- pdbaln(files, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

```{r}
pdbs
```

```{r}
library(bio3dview)

view.pdbs(pdbs)
```

```{r}
# Perform PCA
pc.xray <- pca(pdbs)
plot(pc.xray)
```

```{r}
plot(pc.xray, pc.axes = c(1,2))
```

```{r}
view.pca(pc.xray)
```

```{r}
# Visualize first principal component
pc1 <- mktrj(pc.xray, pc=1, file="pc_1.pdb")
```

We can view this trajectory in Mol-star...
